description: Run a job with the owner's portable browser profile on a chosen provider (steel | browseruse | modal | browserbase). The profile's session state is restored only after the live browser passes the bundle's fingerprint gate. Returns a structured result: COMPLETED, REFUSED (fingerprint mismatch, or the plan's runs-at-a-time limit is in use — nothing ran), or LOGIN_REQUIRED (a pause, not a failure: the carried login did not hold; route the handoff to the named designated human). On LOGIN_REQUIRED the result carries a `handoff` handle (live-session URL + token) for steel/browseruse/browserbase, unless the caller passes handoff: false; modal exposes no host-side session and reports handoffUnavailable.

bundle.description: Owner-held bundle directory (default: the configured default bundle).

handoff.description: Offer a streamed human handoff on a LOGIN_REQUIRED pause (default: true; steel/browseruse/browserbase only).

job.description: Job name — labels the run and its metrics record.

name: profile_run
